title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.13348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed th

translated_title: ProTEUS：一个面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变解析世界模型
translated_abstract: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度地形中导航，微小的序列变化可能产生巨大的功能差异，但实验筛选只能采样序列空间中很小的一部分。因此，一个核心挑战是如何在计算机中高效地遍历庞大的组合突变空间。我们提出了ProTEUS，一个面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变解析世界模型。ProTEUS在深度突变扫描实验数据上进行预训练，利用MutationFormer（一种突变偏置的注意力架构）学习序列、进化和结构信息的联合表示。变体被表示为该联合潜在空间中的状态，而突变则定义为动作，其功能后果可被预测。为了支持对大量突变体的探索，我们开发了一种快速的、物理约束的全原子预测器，该预测器通过显式的几何约束强制机制实现了超过10倍的速度提升。
tldr: 该论文提出ProTEUS——一个基于深度突变扫描预训练的突变解析世界模型，通过MutationFormer突变偏置注意力架构联合建模序列、进化与结构信息，并配合快速的物理约束全原子预测器，实现了闭环蛋白质进化中突变空间的高效计算探索与功能预测。
en_tdlr: ProTEUS is a mutation-resolved world model pretrained on deep mutational scanning that jointly encodes sequence, evolutionary, and structural information via a mutation-biased attention architecture (MutationFormer), paired with a fast physics-constrained all-atom predictor, enabling efficient in silico exploration of combinatorial mutation space for closed-loop protein evolution.
